description: Explicit baseline shard renames, splits, or removals. Replacement keys must upload successfully before an old key is excused.

changes.reason: The CPU filter excluded both GPU-tagged classes and executed zero cases. Recovery and concurrency now run as Required GPU recovery and concurrency on the capability-verified CUDA lane, required by Validation Gate before any validation certificate can be published. The replacement asserts exact discovery/execution identities, numerical results, actual device launches, and no fallback; no CPU coverage is removed.

Two changes shrank the VisionLanguage conformance set from 173 to 166 models: #2136 moved EmuEdit, MGIE and SmartEdit onto LatentDiffusionModelBase (diffusion models do not implement IShapeContract; the diffusion test bases check them instead), and #2269 removed four duplicate VisionLanguage document models (Donut, LayoutLMv3, Nougat and Pix2Struct under src/VisionLanguage/Document; the document implementations elsewhere remain). Offset 165 now ends it and the offset 170 window selects none.
